sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Chandan Kumar Chaturvedi,Ravindra Kumar Srivastava

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ms. Nand Prabha Shukla,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

The present application u/s 483 Cr.P.C. has been filed with prayer to direct the learned Judicial Magistrate/FTC (Women) Azamgarh to expedite the Criminal Case No. 185 of 2015 (State vs. Nitesh and others) arising out of Case Crime No. 455 of 2012 under Sections 498A, 323, 324, 406 IPC,
Police Station Mehnagar, District Azamgarh expeditiously within stipulated period.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that the matter is pending consideration before the court concerned.
Expeditious disposal of a case is the right of every litigant and it is expected from every Court to endeavour to dispose of a case pending before it, expeditiously.
Smt. Sarita Devi vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 12 November, 2024

entities.text: Sarita Devi vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned A.G.A. has no objection in this regard.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and submission made by learned counsel for applicant, it is expedient to direct the court concerned to make its endeavour to decide the case as expeditiously as possible without granting any unnecessary or long adjournments to either of the parties, if there is no other legal impediment.
With the aforesaid directions, the application stands disposed of finally.
